metaphors.title: Proletarization of the mind
metaphors.paraphrase: Like workers deskilled by machinery, users of AI lose the knowledge they delegate: it does not empower us, it proletarizes us, and our attention becomes inventory sold to advertisers.
metaphors.style_hint: A factory floor with idle looms and a ledger of lost skills.

metaphors.title: The god-machine
metaphors.paraphrase: Models are fantastic oracles with encyclopedic knowledge, a quasi-divine authority that hands down verdicts to the faithful.
metaphors.style_hint: A shrine housing a humming server rack.

metaphors.title: Cogs and button-pushers
metaphors.paraphrase: Will mathematicians become button-pushers operating the cogs of the machine, an oracle that eats a paper and spits out YES or NO?
metaphors.style_hint: A control panel of identical buttons.

metaphors.title: Remedy and poison
metaphors.paraphrase: Following Stiegler's pharmakon, AI is at once a remedy and a poison for the mathematical mind.
metaphors.style_hint: An apothecary with two bottles, one cure and one toxin.

metaphors.title: Ergodic drift to a boring average
metaphors.paraphrase: AI-influenced research converges, as the ergodic theorem says, to a boring average: the time average of a homogenized field.
metaphors.style_hint: A trajectory spiralling into a single grey point.
